derived_from: human-adopted C+ workflow, same-source T1-OMP/T1-Codex evidence, and repeated human preference for the T1-Codex final English
change_summary: Move ordinary MPI Buddhist document translation to the independent T1-Codex quality Skill. Retain this package as the locked provider runtime, explicit T1-OMP rollback, and compatibility implementation for historical semantic and pretranslation experiments.

selection_evidence.new_human_feedback: The user reported that 2026-08-27 human review consistently found T1-Codex slightly better than T1-OMP.
selection_evidence.prior_model_diagnostic: A prior same-source model-only diagnostic preferred T1-OMP by a small margin but explicitly was not named human adjudication.
selection_evidence.decision_rule: When both drafts pass blocking semantic and structural gates, direct human whole-draft English judgment outranks model scores, finding counts, backtranslation, length, and mechanical QA.
selection_evidence.approval_scope: strategy routing only; no future target is pre-approved

installer_runtime.purpose: locked repositories, OMP, credentials, public provider smoke, fault injection, and explicit T1-OMP fallback

source_authority.conflict_resolution: original source wins; unresolved core ambiguity requires a named human decision

default_routing.scope: MPI Chinese-to-English Buddhist books, articles, and documents
default_routing.missing_selected_skill: block and report installation requirement; never silently downgrade

t1_codex_quality.english_owner: current Codex task configured as GPT-5.6-Sol/high
t1_codex_quality.provider_runtime: locked OMP for Flash/high and fresh Pro/max only

t1_omp_rollback.activation: explicit request, T1-Codex role unavailability, failed production gate, or bounded blinded comparison

t1_1_2_semantic_restructuring.activation: explicit historical validation or isolated experiment

t1_2_human_quality_pretranslation.activation: explicit isolated experiment with named hash-bound human artifact

t1_2_ai_scale_pretranslation.activation: explicit isolated experiment plus pretranslation readiness and comparison evidence

translation_and_self_review.use: explicit T1-OMP rollback and public runtime smoke only

adopted_into_t1_codex: high-risk-only Chinese clarification and English structure planning
kept_experimental: quality claims based on rewrite count, shorter output, or aggregate model score

lossless_omp_execution.default_t1_codex_scope: Flash/high and fresh Pro/max stages only
required_properties: one complete assistant artifact per existing stage or bounded segment
fail closed on input mutation, empty output, invalid schema, or incomplete coverage
reuse only exact hash-bound validated artifacts
count receipt-backed model invocations rather than OMP events

release_validation.comparison: same frozen source, terminology, review gates, and anonymous human adjudication against T1-OMP rollback
release_validation.pass_rule: T1-Codex wins or ties every genre, adds no unresolved critical or major defect, and shows no recurring Chinese-understanding failure

legacy_compatibility.t1_2_pretranslation: human_quality and ai_scale runners remain available only by explicit selection
